title: The Old Drain Opens
short_role: Choose whether a newly exposed wall passage becomes masonry or an emergency route.
setup: A loose stone beside the Outer Wall reveals a narrow drain. The wet marks prove where it runs; sealing it preserves certainty, while marking it keeps one visible escape route without removing any current defense.

choices.label: Seal the drain
choices.visible_result: The drain is sealed and recorded as stable masonry.

choices.label: Mark the emergency route
choices.visible_result: The drain remains a marked emergency route; every existing defensive counter stays available.
